business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides financial public relations, financial printing and international roadshow coordination services, with financial PR contributing all 2025 revenue after roadshow revenue fell to nil.

segments.name: Provision of financial public relations services
segments.source: Annual Report 2025 note 5, segment revenue and results, pp.87-88

segments.name: Organisation and coordination of international roadshows
segments.source: Annual Report 2025 note 5, segment revenue and results, pp.87-88

business_overview.revenue_model: Project-based services are recognised when services/events are completed; IPO financial printing and subscription PR services can be recognised over time. Billing is generally monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or within about 30 days after completion/listing.
business_notes: More than 90% of revenue arose in Hong Kong in 2025.
No individual customer accounted for over 10% of revenue.
The group also holds substantial time deposits, listed bonds, listed equities, unlisted funds, properties, investment properties and a club debenture.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: credit impairment on financial assets, not recurring operating service profit

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow was positive in 2023-2025 and capital expenditure was very small, but reported profit is heavily affected by bank interest, bond impairment, FVTOCI/FVTPL movements and FX; sustainable distributable cash profit therefore uses an adjusted post-tax operating cash estimate rather than reported net profit.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of financial position, pp.47-48
Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of financial position and note 22, pp.47,110
Annual Report 2025 consolidated cash flow statement, p.52

gaps: Annual report does not split bank balances/time deposits by parent company versus subsidiaries, nor by Hong Kong/offshore versus PRC operating entities.

Annual report does not provide a formal restricted cash line; absence of pledge at 31 March 2025 is used as evidence only for pledged asset release, not proof that every deposit can be immediately remitted.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not separately disclosed; cash capex is used as a conservative low-capex service-company proxy.
